clauses.text: Bids must be uploaded on the e-procurement portal no later than 14 December 2026, 15:00 IST.
The technical bid shall not exceed 60 pages. Annexures are excluded from the page count.
The bidder shall submit the following with the technical bid:
a signed covering letter in the format of Annexure 1;
a power of attorney for the authorised signatory; and
the integrity pact, signed on every page.
The selected bidder shall operate the primary data centre on a 24x7x365 basis with an uptime of at least 99.982 percent measured monthly.
Planned maintenance windows shall be agreed with the Purchaser at least 72 hours in advance.
The bidder shall provide consolidated monthly reports on capacity, incidents and changes.
The bidder shall provide office space for five resident engineers at the DR site.
The bidder shall maintain register number 1 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 2 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 3 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 4 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 5 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 6 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 7 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 8 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 9 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 10 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 11 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 12 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall maintain register number 13 for asset tracking as per the asset policy.
The bidder shall ensure that all backup media are encrypted with AES-256 and stored in a fire-proof safe at a location at least 50 km from the primary data centre.
Security operations shall include:
24x7 monitoring through a SIEM;
quarterly vulnerability assessment and penetration testing;
incident response within 30 minutes for severity 1 incidents.
Bids not meeting any pre-qualification criterion will be rejected without further evaluation.
All data shall reside within India at all times.
The Purchaser reserves the right to cancel the tender at any stage.

table_rows.criteria: The bidder must hold a valid ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certificate.
The bidder must have an average annual turnover of at least INR 50 crore in the last three financial years.
The bidder must have operated at least one Tier III data centre for a government client.
